content:
The type of project delivery that is concerned with all aspects of building performance and requires coordination of different building systems to avoid rework is:

A. integrated

Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) is a collaborative approach that involves all stakeholders (owners, architects, engineers, contractors, and subcontractors) from the early stages of the project. It focuses on optimizing building performance, reducing waste, and improving efficiency through continuous coordination and integration of various building systems. This method contrasts with more traditional, sequential approaches where each phase is completed before the next one begins.
